message: 熱病の夜
Someone's at the front door....
Sally wouldn't open the front door and go out, and I'm right here....

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」
I bolt upright!

name: Paqy
message: 「Is something the matter, Master Synn?」
I strip off my nightclothes

name: Paqy
message: 「Half-naked out of nowhere! Could you be after the great me?!」
and quickly get dressed.

name: Paqy
message: 「Guh. Being a familiar is rough. Still, I am a man once called a Great Sage! I'm prepared for this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Watch the house while I'm gone!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel?!」
Even though I told him to let me know before going out for a night walk.
And he's not even in top shape.

name: Synn
message: 「*Cough, cough*」
Guess I'm in no position to talk.
I felt something cold on the tip of my nose.

name: Synn
message: 「...Rain」
If I don't hurry, it's going to pour.

name: Synn
message: 「Achoo!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
Found him!

name: Synn
message: 「Let's hurry back」

name: Azel
message: 「...Go back. I want to walk alone」

name: Synn
message: 「No!」
I grabbed Azel's hand.
It was a small, smooth hand.

name: Synn
message: 「You're this cold」

name: Azel
message: 「M-My body temperature is just low」

name: Synn
message: 「Either way, tonight is no good」

name: Synn
message: 「It's going to start pouring soon. No matter how much you like night walks, tonight isn't the weather for one」

name: Synn
message: 「Any night other than tonight, I'll gladly go with you as much as you want. Just not tonight」
I took Azel's hand and started walking.
I thought she might resist a little, but Azel obediently came along with me.

name: Synn
message: 「*Cough*, *hack, hack*」

name: Azel
message: 「You... even though you're not feeling well」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you went out alone because you were worried about me?」

name: Azel
message: 「N-No! I just wanted to go out on my own」

name: Synn
message: 「It's already cold out, so I wouldn't recommend going for a walk when you're not in top shape」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I am fine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'm fine too」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't lie! I know full well that you're not doing well!」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks for worrying about me. I'll go straight to sleep once we get back, so I'll be fine」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I'm worried about you or anything--」
Azel took a deep breath, then murmured as if exhaling a heavy weight.

name: Azel
message: 「Yes... I am always worried about you」
My hand was squeezed back.

name: Azel
message: 「I do not know since when. Yet, I am always thinking of you. It is utterly illogical, and I do not even understand myself. Even so, that is how it is」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...」
Something stirs deep inside my chest. A strange feeling I've never felt toward anyone before.
It makes me want to pull the girl beside me into a tight hug.

name: Azel
message: 「That's why I'm more worried about you. After all, you care about everyone, don't you? Even if it weren't me, you'd still come to bring them back like this, wouldn't you?」
Of course I would.
I was about to answer that, yet for some reason the words wouldn't come out of my mouth.

name: Synn
message: 「...Right now, the only one I'm worried about is you, Azel.」
Right now, at least for right now.
But is it really just right now?
Haven't I been thinking about her constantly lately?
My cheeks felt hot. For some reason, I couldn't look at Azel's face.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, it's--it's pouring! We have to get back fast.」
The strength gripping my hand suddenly slipped away.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...?」
When I looked back,

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh! Hah, hah... ngh!」
Azel had crouched down, clutching around her chest.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!」
Excuse me! Due to an emergency, I'm coming into your room!
First, I'll get Azel off my back and lay her down on the tatami...

name: Synn
message: 「*Cough, cough*」
My head feels kind of heavy... This might be bad...
Still, getting Azel laid down comes first right now.
A remarkably Spartan room.
A single set of casual clothes hanging on the wall, and way too many uniforms.
Several photographs taped to the wall.
A Leica and a digital camera lined up in the corner of the room, along with a few rolls of spare film.
Completely unadorned--

name: Synn
message: 「I-I think leaving your underwear piled up carelessly is a l-little questionable!」
C-calm down, me.
There's no heating appliance in sight.
And a futon that looks like it's just been left laid out.

name: Azel
message: 「Hah, hah, hah...」
Azel's body was burning up enough that I could tell without even touching her, and she had gone completely limp.
I'll lay her down on the futon...

name: Synn
message: 「N-no, before that, a towel?! Warm water? Definitely a towel, right?」
B-but wiping her body down with a towel means...
That means I have to take her clothes off, doesn't it?!

name: Synn
message: 「W-whoa. W-whoa, whoa! *Hack, hack*」
I-I'm getting dizzy. In more ways than one.

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, help!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan!」
She's not here!? Did she go back to the Demon World to pick up some Demon World Mail-Order goods or something...?

name: Synn
message: 「D-does that mean... I have no choice but to undress her!? *cough, cough*」
My head is spinning. Crap, I'm running a fever. In more ways than one, honestly.
Me undress her!? Strip Azel completely naked!? N-no, even if I don't go all the way and just leave her in her underwear. No, wait, how is that any better!?
I mean, I don't have any ulterior motives or anything. Still, is it really okay for someone like me to take a girl's clothes off!?
But this is an emergency, and if I leave her soaked like this, she'll catch a serious cold....

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Looking closely, Azel's clothes seemed completely dry.

name: Synn
message: 「Even though she was so drenched...?」
I lay Azel down on the futon.

name: Synn
message: 「Phew... but why?」
A fever? Did they dry from Azel's body heat? If that's the case....

name: Synn
message: 「That's bad! *cough, cough*」
There's not a moment to lose!

name: Synn
message: 「*Ahem, ahem, hack, cough*」
I need to bring the heater from my room to Azel's room.

name: Paqy
message: 「Gaa-guu...」
The heater is...

name: Synn
message: 「The heater, I have to take it」
Ah, the world is spinning. It's spinning.
